en.headline: Bureau names eight firms as industrial elite enterprises
en.dek: The Innovation, Technology and Industry Bureau said the inaugural list follows more than 100 nominations, with an award ceremony expected before the end of the year.
body: The Innovation, Technology and Industry Bureau on Monday named eight companies as the first New Industrialisation Elite Enterprises under a nurturing scheme tied to Hong Kong's first five-year plan and the 2026 Policy Address.

Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong said the scheme is meant to support high-growth firms developing in Hong Kong and to raise recognition of a "Made in Hong Kong" enterprise brand. The bureau said the award is honorary and that a presentation ceremony is expected before the end of this year.

The bureau said it received more than 100 nominations, spanning life and health technology, artificial intelligence and robotics, semiconductors and smart devices, digital upgrading, and future and sustainable industries, as well as traditional sectors using technology to transform. Selection rested on research capability, growth potential, and local contribution and ecosystem impact.

The annex to the announcement lists Westwell Holdings (Hong Kong) Limited, FJ Dynamics International Limited, Hestia Technology Limited, JinTech Semiconductor Co., Limited, GenieBiome Limited, CATALO Natural Health Science Limited, Phase Scientific International Limited and Wai Yuen Tong Medicine Company Limited.

zh.headline: 創科局公布首屆八家新型工業菁英企業
zh.dek: 創新科技及工業局說，計劃接獲逾100項提名，評審看科研、成長和本地貢獻，頒獎禮預計今年內舉行。
body: 創新科技及工業局星期一公布首屆「新型工業菁英企業培育計劃」名單，八家企業獲授榮譽。局方說，計劃呼應香港第一個五年規劃和2026年施政報告中加快構建新型工業化體系的方向，亦屬教育、科技、人才和產業一體化的措施。
局長孫東表示，計劃旨在重點扶植一批在港發展、具高增長性的企業，希望提高「香港製造」企業品牌的認受性和知名度。局方說，獲選企業獲授的是榮譽稱號，頒獎典禮預計今年內舉行。
局方說，計劃收到逾100項提名，涵蓋生命健康科技、人工智能與機械人、半導體與智能設備、數字化與升級轉型、未來與可持續發展，以及以創科升級的傳統優勢產業。遴選以科研能力、成長性，以及本地貢獻和生態影響為三項核心指標。
公告附件列出的八家企業為西井控股（香港）有限公司、豐疆智能國際有限公司、燧氏科技有限公司、晉達半導體有限公司、精進微生物科技有限公司、家得路天然健康科學有限公司、相達生物科技國際有限公司和位元堂藥廠有限公司。
